hook: AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to start a business. I needed 3.
caption:
AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to start a business. I needed 3.

Here's what actually happened:

I asked ChatGPT to help me launch a freelance design service. It gave me a beautiful, comprehensive, completely overwhelming roadmap. Business plan. LLC formation. Trademark research. A content calendar. A CRM system.

I hadn't even landed my first client yet.

The AI wasn't wrong. It just didn't know *me*.

It didn't know I freeze when there's too much on the table. That I work in sprints, not systems. That I need a "what's the ONE thing" answer before I can move.

That's the gap nobody talks about. AI is trained to be thorough. You might be wired to be fast.

When your thinking style and the AI's default output style don't match — you get friction. You get paralysis. You get a 47-step plan collecting dust in a tab you'll never open again.

BootFile fixes the mismatch. It builds a profile of how *you* think — your pace, your depth preference, your decision style — and gives that context to AI before you even ask a question.

Same question. Completely different answer.

The version that actually gets used.
